events.title: Demo v1.40: skill upgrades, new area & story cutscenes
events.summary: Demo v1.40 is a substantial content update, with new ways to develop Gu Gui's skills and more to discover along the journey. Thank you to everyone who has tried Necro Rising during Steam Next Fest! What's new Upgrade Gu Gui's Taoist skills. Each of his five skills now has two upgrade levels in the Bone Forge's new Rites tab, paid for with souls and materials, with no Soul Crystals required; the second level unlocks after clearing the North Pass. events.summary: Demo v1.30 adds 12 new languages, clearer corpses and a smoother lamp minigame. Thanks to everyone trying Necro Rising during Steam Next Fest and sharing feedback. What's new 12 new languages. events.title: Demo v1.21: automatic language on first launch
events.summary: Demo v1.21 is a small language update: on first launch, the game now selects Chinese or English automatically if no language setting has been saved. Language selection uses your Steam language first, or your system language if Steam language is unavailable. Chinese settings select Chinese; other languages default to English. Saved language settings are kept. The language option is easier to find: open the title menu and choose Settings / 语言. The game version is now 1.21. Found something unclear?

events.title: Demo 1.0: Necro Rising has been relaunched
events.summary: Necro Rising has been rebuilt from the ground up.The earlier four-chapter campaign and Tide Rush modes have been retired. The game has been remade around Return: a new dark Eastern fantasy story, full Chinese voice-over, ink-wash story illustrations and redrawn pixel characters. Raising the fallen into your legion is still at its heart, now joined by calling the dead home and rebuilding your camp. Free Demo 1.0 is the first build of the relaunched game, and it is available now.The storyBetrayed
